{{incomplete}} {{Infobox location |type=road |location_name=Vicinity of Tahnti Station |japanese_name=タンティ{{tt|駅前|えきまえ}} |translated_name=Vicinity of Tahnti Station |location=South of [[Tahnti Park]] |region=Ryme City |generation={{gen|VI}}/{{gen|VII}} |mapdisplay=no }} The '''vicinity of Tahnti Station''' (Japanese: '''タンティ{{tt|駅前|えきまえ}}''' ''Vicinity of Tahnti Station'') is a road located in the downtown of [[Ryme City]] near [[Tahnti Park]] in the game {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}}. The first part of Chapter 1 takes place here. ==Events== * Track Down the Aipom! * Figure out where Aipom went! ==Case Notes== ===Evidence=== ;Necklace :It belongs to the girl, but Aipom took it. It's apparently an important item she got from her mother. ;Ketchup tail print :A red mark in the shape of Aipom's tail. We found it on the path that leads to the park. ;Paint tail print :A white mark shaped like Aipom's tail. ===Testimony=== ;The Aipom that ran away to the park :It came down from the roof and ran along the path to the park. ;The Aipom that ran away to the bank :It jumped over our heads and ran along the path to the bank. ;Aipom with ketchup on it :It had the necklace. ===People=== ;Girl :Her necklace was taken by Aipom. I have to get it back. ;[[Emilia Christie|Woman]] :She's with the girl whose necklace was taken. ===Pokémon=== ;[[Detective Pikachu (character)|Pikachu]] :"The detective hat is his trademark" :For some reason, he can only talk to me. I still can't believe it. He seems kind of pompous. ;{{p|Aipom}} :"Loves to make mischief" :It took the girl's necklace. We chased it but lost sight of it. ;{{p|Furfrou}} :"A fur fashionista" :Its fur is all messed up. It was really sad. ;{{p|Diggersby}} :"Really digs digging" :It's good at digging holes.
